title: a16z Podcast: Fintech Revolution or Evolution?

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: How far along are we towards the vision of a "cashless, cardless, walletless, frictionless future" for fintech?
reader_summary.overview: How far along are we towards the vision of a "cashless, cardless, walletless, frictionless future" for fintech? We're not quite there yet. But as revolutionary as the chip tech seems, the reality may be that fintech innovation is much more incremental, evolutionary.

key_points.text: But as revolutionary as the chip tech seems, the reality may be that fintech innovation is much more incremental, evolutionary.
Will that change now that Apple Pay is coming to the web?
